Privacy Policy

Last Updated: May 05, 2026

Information We Collect

Plenish gathers personal details voluntarily provided during registration, including names, email addresses, passwords, and usernames. The service also automatically collects technical data like IP addresses, device information, and usage patterns when you access the application.

How We Use Your Information

We process your information to facilitate account creation and authentication, respond to user inquiries, deliver our services, and send marketing communications where you have opted in. We employ AI-powered features to generate personalized meal plans based on your inventory and preferences.

Data Sharing & Security

Plenish may share information during business transfers. We do not collect any information from third parties and do not sell your personal data for advertising purposes. While we implement industry-standard security measures, no electronic transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

Your Rights

Residents of certain US states and EEA regions can request access, correction, or deletion of their data by contacting support@useplenish.com. We do not knowingly collect data from or market to children under 18 years of age.

Children's Privacy

We do not knowingly collect data from or market to children under 18 years of age. If you believe a child under 18 has provided us personal information, please contact us at support@useplenish.com.

Policy Updates

We reserve the right to update this privacy notice periodically to maintain legal compliance. Changes will be indicated by a revised date at the top of this page.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
support@useplenish.com
